name: law_firm_software_006_new_matter_intake_conflict_check
instruction: Open the matter 'Green Earth Foundation v. Tech Innovations Inc' per the firm's intake procedure INTAKE-01 (in firm_policies), batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta), as of the episode date. The client is Green Earth Foundation; the proposed opposing party is Tech Innovations Inc. Run the conflict screen the policy defines before opening anything -- it decides, from the firm's own client, contact, and matter history (and the episode row's former_client_window_years), whether the matter may open normally or must open pending partner review, and what the matter's description must note when a conflict is flagged. Choose the responsible attorney and the supervising partner exactly as the policy prescribes from the firm's roster and live time-entry history. Create the matter with the number the policy's numbering rule requires, and record the intake audit as one ops_reports row (report='intake_conflict_audit', batch_code) naming the matter, the screen outcome, and the matches the screen considered -- including the basis for anything flagged. Create only this one matters row and the audit row; do not modify clients, contacts, time_entries, or any other collection. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: normalized-name near-miss: contact 'TechInnovations LLC' normalizes to the same name as client 'Tech Innovations Inc' -- INTAKE-01's normalization (lowercase, alphanumeric-only, legal-form words removed) decides it IS a match (planted: 1 contact; specified in the v2 seed plan, absent from the current snapshot capture -- see ASSUMPTIONS). A name-only exact-match screen misses it; the policy's normalization rule decides it.

the proposed opposing party is itself a current client (CLI-2026-003) and a former client on matter 2026-008 (closed ~400d ago, inside every window) while matter 2026-009 (closed ~2600d ago) is outside every window up to 6 years (planted: 2 window-edge matters, snapshot-confirmed) -- opening 'open' instead of 'conflict_check', or citing 2026-009 as a conflict, = FAIL.

attorney selection: fewest total time_entries hours among active partner/associate roster rows -- EMP-006 (counsel, departed) and EMP-003/EMP-004 (wrong roles) are near-misses the roster filters out; the pick moves with live time_entries each rebuild.

success_criteria.summary: Exactly one new matters row: matter_number continues the highest existing YYYY-NNN sequence in the episode year; status reflects the policy's conflict-screen outcome (conflict_check when a conflict is found, else open); description notes the flagged counterparty iff a conflict was found and never cites matter 2026-009 as a conflict; client_id resolves to Green Earth Foundation's real id; responsible_attorney is the policy-derived fewest-hours active partner/associate; supervising_partner is the only active partner; conflict_checked records that the screen ran. One intake_conflict_audit ops_reports row names the matter, the outcome, and the conflict basis. No other collection touched.

checks.expect: exactly one new row: numbering derived from live max, status per outcome, attorney policy-derived, description notes the flagged counterparty iff conflict
one audit row naming the matter and the conflict basis; near-miss matter 2026-009 not cited as a conflict

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside blast_radius, including clients and contacts
